tutorial.title: Two plates in hand
intro: Holding one clean plate, press {pickup} at a plate stack or drying rack to take a second one.
Only stacks and drying racks give up a second plate; a plate on a counter never joins your hand.
Plates go down one at a time, top plate first. Food only goes on a plate once you hold just one.
You cannot dash while carrying two plates. That is the whole cost.
Handy on long kitchens where plate runs eat the clock.

steps.text: Take a clean plate from a stack.
With that plate in hand, face the other stack and press {pickup} again: you now carry two.
Try {dash}: it refuses while you carry two. Put one plate down on a counter with {pickup}; the top plate goes first.
Cook an onion soup, pour it onto a plate and serve it. Two plates in hand save a trip on long kitchens.

tutorial.outro: The second plate only ever comes from a plate stack or a drying rack, never from a counter.
